snippet.title: National Geographic
snippet.description:
Step into wonder and find your inner explorer with National Geographic. 

National Geographic is the world's premium destination for science, exploration, and adventure. Welcome to the National Geographic community, where we bring our stories, images and video to the world in real-time, inviting followers along on our ongoing 138-year journey. Our yellow border is a portal to the world, showcasing all of the wonder and beauty that it has to offer. This page allows our fans to join us while promoting an enriching and supportive climate for our community. Therefore, we do not tolerate words of hate, harassment or disparagement. We reserve the right to remove any posting or other material that we find off-topic, inappropriate or objectionable.

snippet.title: LuxPlanes
snippet.description:
Welcome to LuxPlanes, an aviation YouTube channel that focuses on education, entertainment, and news! The goal of the LuxPlanes YouTube channel is to help people fall in love with aviation and learn interesting facts about flying.

My real name is Ryan, I'm a 20-year-old student pilot aiming to become an airline pilot. If all this sounds cool to you, feel free to subscribe to my channel to join me on my journey to the flight deck. Also, for all bus lovers, I am passionate about public transport, particularly buses.

snippet.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
snippet.description:
Learn exactly how every air disaster happened, and why. Every case is reconstructed clue by clue, built for viewers who want to understand the failure, not just watch it unfold.

Investigating the unthinkable.

Revealing the dark truth that aviation safety improves one crash at a time, Mayday: Air Disaster investigates legendary aviation disasters to find out what went wrong and why. Based on cockpit voice recorders, accident reports, and eyewitness accounts, every episode also features interviews, gripping reenactments, and state-of-the-art CGI.

From maintenance issues and dangerous cargo to extreme weather, investigators need to find the exact cause to ensure it never happens again. They owe it to the victims, the survivors, and their families to examine every clue and ultimately crack the case.

snippet.title: Flight Disasters
snippet.description:
Every plane crash starts with something small…
and ends in disaster.

Welcome to Flight Disasters, where we break down real aviation accidents, uncover hidden mistakes, and reveal the chain reactions that brought aircraft down.

From pilot decisions to mechanical failures, every story is told step by step so you understand what really happened.

Subscribe if you want to see the truth behind aviation disasters.

snippet.description:
Welcome to the OFFICIAL Curious? Science and Engineering Youtube Channel.

Be inspired to take an exciting leap into the world of science and engineering! From wacky experiments to moments that will change people's lives forever, we've got something for everyone to explore.

Understand how projects and operations shape countries along with how some creations have stood out from the rest of the world. Feeling curious? Good, we've got just the channel you're looking for.
